name: appleVppTokens
description: Apple Volume Purchase Program location tokens with their state, expiry and last sync

metadata.name: health
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const s = $['state']; if (s === 'expired') { return 'Expired'; } if (s === 'invalid') { return 'Invalid'; } if (s === 'assignedToExternalMDM') { return 'Assigned to another MDM'; } const t = new Date($['expirationDateTime']).getTime(); if (!$['expirationDateTime'] || isNaN(t)) { return 'Unknown'; } const days = (t - Date.now()) / 86400000; if (days < 0) { return 'Expired'; } if ($['lastSyncStatus'] === 'failed') { return 'Sync failed'; } return days <= 30 ? 'Expiring soon' : s === 'valid' ? 'Valid' : 'Unknown'; })() }}

metadata.name: daysUntilExpiry
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const t = new Date($['expirationDateTime']).getTime(); return !$['expirationDateTime'] || isNaN(t) ? null : Math.floor((t - Date.now()) / 86400000); })() }}
